A FEW WAYS IN

About this experiment

DRAG / ARROWS TO PAN · SCROLL TO ZOOM · SPACE STEPS CONSTRUCTION

The mathematics

Replace the middle third of every edge with two sides of an outward equilateral triangle. Each edge becomes four edges, each one-third as long. Recursion depth sets the target; Construction progress raises the next generation of triangular peaks. Space advances one complete generation and wraps to the initial triangle. The perimeter grows without bound while the area approaches 8/5 of the starting triangle. The limiting boundary has dimension log 4 / log 3; every finite rendering is a polygonal approximation.
